observed_current_architecture: RetinaFrameSignal already separates quality_micros from delta_micros and binds delta to one exact reference frame id and sha256.
RetinaPolicy already separates min_quality_micros from salient_delta_micros and applies them independently before emitting only a PerceptEvent candidate.
retina_pipeline explicitly consumes caller-supplied measurements only; it does not read pixels or persist raw frames.
CaptureBroker v3 already provides bounded immutable frame references with source sequence, monotonic time, payload digest and bounded rolling provenance.
Existing tests prove delta-reference identity, continuity, digest and authority fences at repository-component scope.

new_architecture_gap.observation: The exact measurement algorithm, normalization, channel semantics, sampling geometry and parameter set are not structurally bound to RetinaFrameSignal or RetinaPolicy. provenance_refs can name a producer informally, but the policy does not require an exact measurement-profile identity/digest before applying numeric thresholds.
new_architecture_gap.failure_mode: Two producers can supply numerically valid micros values generated by different metrics or normalizations, while the same RetinaPolicy interprets them as comparable. Exact signal digests then preserve the wrong semantic contract perfectly rather than rejecting it.
new_architecture_gap.scope: SOURCE/ABI GAP ONLY; NOT OBSERVED TARGET-RUNTIME FAILURE

minimum_architecture_delta.gate: assess_retina_transition must fail closed before threshold comparison when current/previous signal profile or policy expected profile does not match exactly.

delta_baseline_candidate.mapping: mean absolute difference of fixed, explicitly specified 8-bit luma samples; normalize 0..255 to integer micros 0..1,000,000 with one canonical rounding rule
delta_baseline_candidate.state: current transient sample grid + immediately previous transient sample grid only
limitations: global illumination/exposure changes can produce large scores
camera motion can dominate without adaptation

adaptive_extension.reason: It introduces multi-frame score-window dependence and detection latency not represented by the existing single-reference delta lineage. It should not silently reuse the same profile id as the one-reference baseline.

quality_secondary_candidate.source_analogy: Wang et al. SSIM / scikit-image structural_similarity
quality_secondary_candidate.reason: SSIM answers a full-reference structural similarity/quality question and needs explicit data range/window/channel semantics. It does not define generic current-frame quality without a declared reference and must not silently become the novelty metric.

dependency_decision.reason: The required architecture value is profile-bound measurement semantics plus a tiny deterministic primitive. Whole-library orchestration/dependency surfaces are not needed to express that contract.

required_falsifiers_before_build_candida: same numeric delta_micros under two different measurement profiles must be rejected by one fixed policy
profile digest mutation or stale generation must fail closed before threshold comparison
fixed-grid luma-MAE normalization must be bit/replay deterministic on declared fixture bytes
no-change, single-pixel, global-illumination, chromatic-only and camera-shift fixtures must expose known sensitivity boundaries
raw pixel bytes must not appear in RetinaFrameSignal, assessment, CaptureBroker durable/reference state or receipt payloads
adaptive-window variants must use a distinct profile and bind all required causal/window provenance rather than masquerading as one-reference delta
hypothesis: The highest-value next Retina improvement is measurement-profile identity binding around the already-existing quality/delta ABI, followed by a tiny deterministic luma-MAE producer falsifier. This preserves the accepted architecture and prevents threshold semantics from drifting across future capture backends.
counterhypothesis: Canonical provenance_refs may already be sufficient if every producer and policy always includes an exact profile digest by convention; if tests prove that invariant end-to-end, adding dedicated profile fields could be redundant schema growth.
cheapest_discriminator: Construct two otherwise identical RetinaFrameSignal values with equal delta_micros but intentionally different measurement-profile identities and prove the current source cannot distinguish them structurally; then test a minimal explicit profile-binding patch on a bounded synthetic fixture before any real-device work.
